entities.summary: Li Dayin is a Chinese weightlifter. He is a World Champion, Asian Champion and has held the snatch junior world record in the defunct 81 kg division, as well as the snatch and total senior world record in the defunct 89 kg division. He won the gold medal in the men's 81 kg event at the 2022 World Weightlifting Championships held in Bogotá, Colombia.
